blocks.text: Era Zero now has 126 canonical roots and 198 provisional roots in 22 nine-root chunks. No completed review packet awaits a decision. The broad English translator remains blocked. A restricted explicit-ID renderer may cover only the 126 canonical roots and must reject provisional meanings, unapproved compounds, and underspecified grammar.
